compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The prior tickets-history reclaim reported a fresh-clone ceiling from `.git/objects/pack/*.pack` only. The rewritten baseline tree itself was already 290,690,203 logical bytes, while the incident investigation on `absurd-zoometric-bobwhite` measured a fresh single-branch clone at 322.57 MiB of pack data, 827,550,463 logical checkout bytes, 1,116,577,792 allocated checkout bytes, and 1,475,424,256 allocated bytes for the whole clone. Operators therefore need one reproducible report that cannot conflate Git packing with checkout residence or filesystem block slack.

A fixed footprint ceiling is explicitly out of scope. Closed bug `bardic-continuous-asianlion` records that a monotonically growing tickets pack ceiling repeatedly blocked every unrelated Gerrit change; `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:397-407` preserves the decision to remove that gate. The operator reaffirmed on 2026-08-23 that hard budgets or shrink-only ratchets introduce unacceptable fragility and workflow friction.

## Approach
Add an explicit, opt-in, read-only `rebar tracker-footprint` command backed by a reusable measurement module. It will never run implicitly from ticket writes, reconciliation, plan/completion gates, Gerrit Verify, or ordinary `rebar metrics`.

Default mode measures the configured mounted tracker and identifies when its Git object database is shared, so local object bytes are not misrepresented as a standalone clone. `--fresh-clone` resolves the configured tickets remote and branch, creates a temporary unfiltered single-branch/no-tags clone with local hardlink optimization disabled, measures it, and removes only that command-owned temporary directory. Both text and schema-validated JSON output report the measured ref/tip and definitions alongside values.

The report separates packed object bytes; checkout logical bytes; checkout allocated bytes when the platform exposes `st_blocks`; file count and allocation slack; Git-directory logical/allocated bytes; and whole-clone logical/allocated bytes. Unsupported allocation accounting is a structured unavailable value, never a fabricated zero. Size is descriptive only: no threshold, pass/fail classification, baseline mutation, alert side effect, or nonzero exit caused solely by a large result.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_store/footprint.py`: reusable filesystem/Git measurement and explicit temporary fresh-clone orchestration.
- `src/rebar/_commands/tracker_footprint.py`: read-only CLI adapter and text/JSON rendering.
- `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/tracker_footprint.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`, and packaged help: register the opt-in command without adding it to write/init paths.
- `src/rebar/schemas/tracker_footprint.schema.json` and `src/rebar/schemas/__init__.py`: machine-readable output contract.
- Focused unit/interface/schema/CLI-registry tests and generated `docs/cli-reference.md`.
- `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md`, and `docs/scale-envelope.md`: define each layer and correct the pack-versus-clone operational guidance.

Out of scope: any budget or ratchet, any CI/Gerrit gate, any scheduled or automatic trigger, any tracker/remote mutation, producer retention changes, or history reclaim.

## Testing
- Happy path: measure a temporary standalone tickets clone containing ordinary files through the library and CLI JSON surface.
- Discriminating fixture: many one-byte files produce a small Git pack but materially larger checkout allocation.
- Shared-object edge: default mode measures a linked worktree without presenting its shared object store as standalone-clone cost.
- Platform edge: a stat result without `st_blocks` leaves logical metrics available and allocation metrics unavailable.
- Failure path: an invalid remote or branch fails before a success report and cleans up only command-owned temporary state.
- Regression: CLI registry, output-schema coverage, generated help/reference, lint, typecheck, and default tests remain green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Fresh-clone JSON identifies the requested tickets ref and resolved tip; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] Packed-object bytes equal the sum of packfiles in the measured standalone clone; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] Checkout logical bytes and file count equal the measured non-Git working-tree files; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] Supported block accounting reports checkout allocated bytes and allocation slack using filesystem block counts; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] A platform without `st_blocks` reports structured allocation-unavailable values while preserving exact logical values; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] Git-directory logical bytes are reported separately from checkout logical bytes; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] Whole-clone logical bytes equal checkout logical plus Git-directory logical bytes; verified by `tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`.
- [x] The JSON report validates against `tracker_footprint.schema.json`; verified by `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_schema_coverage.py`.
- [x] A many-small-files fixture exposes materially larger checkout allocation than pack bytes without emitting a threshold verdict or size-based failure; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] Mounted linked-worktree mode labels its object database as shared rather than standalone; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] An invalid fresh-clone remote or branch exits nonzero without a success report; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] Fresh-clone failure removes only the temporary directory created by this command; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] A successful report leaves the source ref, mounted tracker HEAD/worktree, and remote refs unchanged; verified by `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py`.
- [x] CLI registry metadata classifies `tracker-footprint` as an explicit read-only route; verified by `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`.
- [x] No ticket-write, reconciler, gate, metrics, or CI path invokes the command; verified by focused repository wiring assertions and review.
- [x] User and reuse documentation defines pack, logical checkout, allocated checkout, Git-directory, and whole-clone layers; verified by documentation review.
- [x] Generated CLI help and reference contain the command and pass their drift checks.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` pass.
- [x] No fixed footprint threshold, shrink-only ratchet, scheduled measurement, or workflow gate is introduced; verified by change review.
